description: This source file defines the ClosureCleaner object and related classes for cleaning Scala closures in Apache Spark, including handling of Scala and Ammonite closures, inner classes, and lambda serialization proxies.

classes.name: ReturnStatementInClosureException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a return statement is detected inside a Spark closure.

classes.name: MethodIdentifier
classes.description: Helper class to uniquely identify a method by class, name, and descriptor.

classes.name: FieldAccessFinder
classes.description: Class for analyzing bytecode to find accessed fields within classes and methods.

classes.name: InnerClosureFinder
classes.description: Class for detecting inner classes and closures within bytecode.

classes.name: IndylambdaScalaClosures
classes.description: Object providing utilities to detect and analyze Scala indylambda closures, including finding accessed fields and nested closures.

methods.name: getClassReader
methods.description: Creates an ASM ClassReader for a given class by reading its bytecode from the class resource stream.

methods.name: isAmmoniteCommandOrHelper
methods.description: Checks if a class name matches Ammonite command or helper classes.

methods.name: isDefinedInAmmonite
methods.description: Checks if a class name indicates it is defined within Ammonite.

methods.name: isClosure
methods.description: Determines if a class represents a Scala closure based on its name.

methods.name: getOuterClassesAndObjects
methods.description: Retrieves outer classes and objects for a given closure object by inspecting $outer fields.

methods.name: getInnerClosureClasses
methods.description: Returns a list of classes representing inner closures within a given closure object.

methods.name: initAccessedFields
methods.description: Initializes the map of accessed fields for outer classes and their superclasses.

methods.name: setAccessedFields
methods.description: Sets the accessed fields in a clone object based on the original object.

methods.name: cloneAndSetFields
methods.description: Clones an object and sets its fields based on the original object.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Main method to clean a closure, nulling out unused references and cloning as needed, handling both Scala and Ammonite closures.

methods.name: cleanNonIndyLambdaClosure
methods.description: Cleans a non-indylambda Scala closure in place, cloning inner classes and updating parent pointers.

methods.name: cleanupScalaReplClosure
methods.description: Nulls out unused fields in Scala REPL closures.

methods.name: cleanupAmmoniteReplClosure
methods.description: Nulls out unused fields in Ammonite command closures and clones relevant objects.
